observations.description: Calle Loiza is the northern boundary of San Juan Moderno; Diez de Andino east and San Jorge west in enumerator district description.
Calle Loiza forms the north boundary of part of San Mateo; San Jorge east and De Diego west. Enumeration boundary is not a street-building date.

observations.note: The Parque description directly names a three-way intersection; Minillas independently mentions de Diego × Loíza.
The San Mateo description uses the named Loíza–Del Parque intersection as boundary start.
The source lists a single named three-street junction; this does not establish that King's Court is McLeary.
Calle Loíza is followed northeast from the King's Court/San Jorge junction to Diez de Andino.
Both descriptions locate the Loíza/Maria Moczo crossing and describe distinct adjoining territorial boundaries.
The text describes a crossing of Loíza with Carretera Insular 57; no equivalence with later route numbers inferred.

observations.description: Ocean Park bounded south by CALLE LOIZA, west by CALLE SANTA ANA, east by RAMBLA DEL ALMIRANTE (including described extension).
observations.interpretive_scope: A census district boundary description, not proof of construction, street dedication, road continuity, or a georeferenced segment.

observations.description: Part of barrio PARK: south boundary CALLE LOIZA; eastern CALLE SANTA ANA; western succession CALLE CORDERO, CALLE MCLEARY and CARRION COURT (including its extension). No exact point locations inferred.
observations.interpretive_scope: A census district boundary description, not proof of construction, street dedication, road continuity, or a georeferenced segment.

observations.description: Part of barrio PARK: south boundary CALLE LOIZA; eastern succession CARRION COURT, CALLE MCLEARY and CALLE CORDERO; western boundary CALLE OJEDA TERRAZA PARK (and extension). This does not identify King's Court with McLeary.
observations.interpretive_scope: A census district boundary description, not proof of construction, street dedication, road continuity, or a georeferenced segment.

observations.description: Barrio Las Marias bounded south by LOIZA RD; west by RAMBLA DEL ALMIRANTE and its described extension. Road-name form differs from CALLE LOIZA in the other ED records; no exact continuity or road identity inferred.
observations.interpretive_scope: A census district boundary description, not proof of construction, street dedication, road continuity, or a georeferenced segment.

contemporary_separate_reference.interpretation: The municipal transit stop list supports modern named crossing references only. It cannot independently authenticate historical intersection dates.

historical_background_separate_reference.interpretation: Map section dates are catalog context only; no readable, individually verified Loíza street vertices entered from this source.
